name: firework-rating
title: FireworkRating
description: control: Five-star rating as a real radio group; hover previews, and each chosen star bursts as a firework (canvas 2D, server-safe, reduced motion -> plain)

item.name: firework-rating
item.summary: control: Five-star rating as a real radio group; hover previews, and each chosen star bursts as a firework (canvas 2D, server-safe, reduced motion -> plain)

useWhen: Asking for a rating at a moment worth celebrating (after a purchase, a finished task, a demo)
avoidWhen: Lists of read-only ratings (show plain stars)
Forms with many ratings in a row

tiers.0: The control alone (server render, reduced motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2): no canvas
tiers.2: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 1.5 with half the particles
tiers.3: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 2 with the full particle count

reducedMotion.description: The stars light up without bursts; no canvas.

input.keyboard: A radio group with roving focus: arrows move and rate (Right/Up up, Left/Down down)

a11y.notes: role=radiogroup with a name and five native buttons with role=radio, aria-checked and names ("3 stars"); one tab stop. The word for the rating is aria-live=polite. Unlit stars keep 3:1 against the dark ground. The firework canvas is aria-hidden.

props.name: label
props.effect: Accessible name of the radio group.

props.name: words
props.type: [string, string, string, string, string, string] | null
props.effect: Words for 0-5 stars, shown and announced; null hides them.

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours of the effect (DESIGN.md A8). custom reads --fb-heat-0..4 from the page.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: the effect stops drawing; the control keeps working.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: CSP nonce for the component's <style> element.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root, merged after the palette variables.

mistakes: The bursts spread about 200 px around the stars: leave room and do not clip the parent.
It sits on a dark ground by design; on a light page put it on a dark card.
Give the group a specific label (what is being rated).
verify: Server HTML has a radiogroup with five radios and one tab stop.
ArrowRight rates and moves focus; the word is announced.
The bursts fade and the loop stops within about two seconds.
